name: memhop-scene
summary: L2 scene manual: list all/active scenes, read topic context within a scene, merge duplicate scenes, delete topics and scenes (memory correction)
trigger: need to view scene lists, read a scene's topic context, merge duplicate scenes or delete wrong memories; scene l2 topic merge delete context

resources.name: ListScenes
resources.desc: List all L2 scenes; returns SceneID/name/depth-1 topic count

resources.name: ActiveSceneIDs
resources.desc: List scene IDs currently active in memory (Dream consolidation targets); inactive scenes stay searchable but are never consolidated

resources.name: SceneContext
resources.desc: Read scene context; returns SceneName/Topics (depth-1 topic metadata incl. L4IDs to fetch raw text by ID) and TopicCount

resources.name: MergeScenes
resources.desc: Merge scenes: primaryID=target scene, secondaryIDs=list of scenes to fold in; all topics of secondary scenes move into the primary scene, then the secondaries are deleted

resources.name: DeleteTopic
resources.desc: Delete one L2 topic with its subtree and L4 raw text (memory correction); cascades to child topics and prunes parent references. Host Go API only — no MCP tool

resources.name: DeleteScene
resources.desc: Delete an entire L2 scene (all topics, L4 raw text and L1 nodes); unknown scene returns ErrNotFound. Host Go API only — no MCP tool

steps.action: Browse all scenes to locate the target
Read the target scene's topic context
Merge duplicated scenes into the primary one
